facts.claim: Only about 34% of product-led companies actively track activation at all
facts.excerpt: Only about 34% of PLG companies actively track activation, the single metric that best predicts whether a free user ever becomes a paying one.

facts.claim: Across 90-plus European e-commerce brands, 36.3% of tests produced a statistically significant win
facts.excerpt: 36.3% produced a statistically significant win across thousands of A/B tests on 90+ European e-commerce brands.

facts.claim: Top-performing programmes run 3 to 5 times more tests than the median, producing 6 to 8 winners a quarter from 36 to 50 tests
facts.excerpt: Top-performing brands run 3-5x more tests per year than the median, with 6-8 winning tests per quarter out of 36-50 tests run.

facts.claim: Quick-commerce platforms report 3x to 5x return on ad spend, while true return after commission and cost of goods runs 1.2x to 2.5x
facts.excerpt: Platform-reported RoAS ranges from 3x to 5x, but true RoAS after commission and cost of goods is 1.2x to 2.5x depending on the platform.

facts.claim: Indian quick commerce splits by GMV into Blinkit near 46%, Swiggy Instamart near 24% and Zepto near 22%
facts.excerpt: Blinkit holds about 46% of the market by GMV, Swiggy Instamart around 24%, and Zepto around 22%.

facts.claim: UPI Autopay mandates ran 175 million transactions in January 2025 against 58 million a year earlier, overtaking card-based recurring payments
facts.excerpt: UPI AutoPay transaction volume reached 175 million in January 2025, compared with 58 million in January 2024
